description: Ministry of Tourism Development and Christian Affairs - Order to specify the fees payable for the registration of tourist hotels and the Licensing of registered tourist hotels the Tourism (Classification of Tourist Hotels) Regulations No. 01 of 2016, the Tourism (Code of Conduct of Tourist Hotels) Regulations No. 02 of 2016, the Tourism (Registration and Licensing of Tourist Hotels) Regulations No. 03 of 2016 and the Tourism (Minimum Capacity and Facilities of Tourist Hotels) Rules No. 01 of 2016 which come into operation w.e.f. 20.04.2016
